description: Antimicrobial susceptibility result whose interpretation is the HL7 v3 ObservationInterpretation code 'I' (Intermediate), which has no member of the five-word enum health v2.5 accepted
notes: Fully synthetic. Susceptibility reporting (S/I/R) is ordinary laboratory output and ordinary FHIR: 'I' is a code in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ObservationInterpretation, which FHIR R4 binds Observation.interpretation to. Under health v2.5 this record was a Violation. health v2.6 accepts the code system's 49 selectable codes.
